review:
Jelly Slice is a 5x4 ways slot set in a sweet factory, built around the Slicer. Before the drop, each reel may get a Slicer that cuts every symbol passing through it into two, three or four pieces, increasing the ways count up to 1,204.

More pieces mean more ways and more chances for matches to connect. Hacksaw rates it 3 out of 5 for volatility, so it plays steadier than many of its titles, and the 10,000x maximum is reachable in every mode. Jenny and Jinny's candy factory looks bright and cheerful.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
